title: OPEN A ROTH IRA: 6 THINGS TO KNOW
series_label: HOW TO OPEN A ROTH IRA STEP BY STEP: 6 THINGS TO KNOW

concepts.title: What A Roth IRA Does
concepts.body: A Roth IRA is a retirement account where your money grows tax-free and comes out tax-free in retirement. You contribute after-tax dollars (no deduction today), but qualified withdrawals — including earnings — are tax-free. The trade: pay tax now, never pay tax on the growth.

visual_spec.callout_text: Pay tax now. Never pay tax on the growth. Qualified withdrawals in retirement are tax-free — including decades of compounding.

concepts.title: 2026 Contribution Limits
concepts.body: You can contribute up to $7,500 to a Roth IRA in 2026, or $8,600 if you're 50 or older (catch-up). The limit applies across all your IRAs combined — Roth, traditional, SEP. Earned income must equal or exceed what you contribute.

concepts.title: The MAGI Phase-Out
concepts.body: Roth eligibility phases out at higher incomes. Single: $153,000–$168,000 MAGI for 2026. Married filing jointly: $242,000–$252,000. Inside the window your limit shrinks proportionally. Above the top, direct contributions are off — use a backdoor Roth or 401(k).

concepts.title: Step 1: Pick The Brokerage
concepts.body: Open the Roth IRA at a brokerage — Fidelity, Schwab, or Vanguard are the three big ones. The IRA itself is the same at each; the difference is the funds and tools you get. All three offer index funds like FXAIX, VOO, or VTI at the lowest fees. Pick by UI and fund lineup.

concepts.title: Steps 2-5: Fund And Invest
concepts.body: (2) Open the Roth IRA online in ~10 minutes. (3) Link your bank account. (4) Transfer your contribution ($7,500 max for 2026). (5) Buy a low-cost S&P 500 index fund (FXAIX, VOO) or target date fund for your retirement year. The cash doesn't grow until you invest it.

concepts.title: Don't Leave It In Cash
concepts.body: Cash in a Roth IRA earns interest but a fraction of what stocks return. The S&P 500 has averaged ~10% annually since 1928 (about 7% after inflation). Investing the money is step 5 for a reason: the IRA wrapper means nothing if the cash sits. Buy VOO, FXAIX, or a target date fund the day you fund it.

visual_spec.callout_text: Cash in a Roth IRA is safe but slow. Invest it in VOO, FXAIX, or a target date fund. The wrapper is the tax break; the fund is the growth.

sources_footer: Sourced from IRS IR-2025-111, IRS Publication 590-A, Fidelity/Schwab/Vanguard account disclosures
